summary: Verified bulk select + bulk approve/reject enhancement across Late Requests, Early Out Requests, and Missed Punch modules. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (empty ids, non-existent id -> skipped, bulk approve with is_lop=true persists status=approved+is_lop=true, bulk approve with is_lop=false, bulk reject persists status=rejected, re-approve returns 'Already processed' skipped, individual (single-row) approve regression still works, non-HR user is 403). Frontend: verified via Playwright that Late/EO/MP Pending tabs show Select-All + per-row checkboxes; selecting rows shows the correct bulk bar ('N Request(s) Selected'); Clear Selection hides the bar and unchecks all; Late & Early-Out bulk-approve dialogs display an LOP Decision dropdown (options 'No LOP' / 'LOP (Loss of Pay)') plus optional remark and the list of selected requests; Missed Punch bulk-approve dialog has NO LOP selector (0 lop-select elements inside mp-bulk-approve-dialog); History tab has no checkboxes (late-select-all count = 0). Bulk approve and bulk reject submissions completed successfully via UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >20k lines (~20294). Consider splitting the Late/EarlyOut/MissedPunch modules into separate routers under /app/backend/routers/ — huge file slows restart (~60-80s) and makes reviews harder.

No HTTP DELETE endpoints exist for late-requests / early-out-requests / missed-punches (tests had to clean up via direct Mongo). If deletion is intentionally disallowed, fine; otherwise add DELETE routes for admin cleanup.

bulk_reject_* endpoints accept a 'reason' field in BulkActionBody but the underlying reject_late_request/reject_early_out_request/reject_missed_punch handlers do not accept/persist a rejection reason — the reason is silently discarded. Either persist it on the record (rejection_reason field) or drop the param from BulkActionBody so the contract is not misleading.
GET /api/late-requests/{id} returns 405 Method Not Allowed (no GET-by-id). Consider exposing GET-by-id for consistency; UI/tests currently need to fetch full list to verify single record state.
seed_data_creation: Test records created with reason prefix 'QATEST_BULK_*' during tests; all cleaned up via Mongo delete_many at end. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk endpoints are stable. Note: preview cluster (Cloudflare) occasionally returns 502 for ~30-60s bursts; tests include a login retry loop. If bulk tests fail with 502 on first run, wait 30s and re-run. Cleanup is idempotent (deletes by reason regex ^QATEST). Do NOT rely on HTTP DELETE for these three resources — none exist.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. Only minor code-review observations documented above.
